title: Ralsei Plushie
description: Adds Ralsei Plushie when you rename a carved pumpkin!
body: To get Ralsei you can rename a carved pumpkin to "Ralsei Plushie". He's based on his hatless look since Deltarune chapter 2 and onwards. You can also put him on your head and stuff, I hope you enjoy, he's pretty cute. OptiFine is required to use
